parameters.description: Twin Lake is reached by a rough 0.8-mile dirt road that passes below the Lower Blue Lake dam and climbs along the lake's north side (4WD recommended; high-clearance 2WD with good traction can sometimes make it). It has a day-use area with a parking lot, picnic area, and restroom; hand-launched, car-top non-motorized boats (e.g. kayaks) can be carried to the water, but there is no formal boat ramp and no camping at the lake itself.

candidates.summary: Day-use only access via rough dirt road past the Lower Blue Lake dam; picnic area and restroom on site; hand-launch/car-top boats only, no formal ramp

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Twin Lake (Region 2, Alpine Co.) for fingerling-size Lahontan Cutthroat Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of June-July. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant, and is distinct from the Twin Lake in Lassen County (Region 1) and the Twin Lake Upper/Lower and Twin Lakes, Mammoth entries in Mono County (Region 6) that also appear in the same document.
